_readme: Handpicked audio library. Drop files in public/sfx and public/music, then add an
entry here describing each one. The render/director step reads this so Claude can
place the RIGHT sound at the RIGHT moment (SFX on cuts/emphasis, music as a bed
ducked under the voice). 'tags' + 'use' guide the choice; 'file' is relative to public/.

sfx.use: an element or card popping in

music.use: drifting, spacious pads — cold-open / futuristic / research-frontier scripts; stays out of the way
darker evening mood — drama, bans, layoffs, 'something changed' scripts; pairs with red/violet accents
safe neutral bed — explainers, tool walkthroughs, anything that shouldn't editorialize the mood
rainy-window cozy — reflective / 'here's what I actually think' scripts; slowest of the set
study-beats focus loop — install / setup / how-to / 'watch it work' tool demos; steady pulse keeps typing beats moving
warmest + most upbeat of the set — wins, launches, 'this is great' recommendations; pairs with green/orange accents
